summary: Sister of John's 3rd-great-grandfather Andrew H. Heffernan; born in Tipperary, she married William Healy and died at Plymouth, Pennsylvania, in 1887.
bio: Catherine Heffernan was baptized in County Tipperary, Ireland, on 6 February 1848, a sister of John's 3rd-great-grandfather Andrew H. Heffernan. She married William Healy, and by 1880 her widowed mother was living with her in Plymouth, Luzerne County, Pennsylvania. Catherine died at Plymouth in 1887.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
